# Sunstone Advisory

> Independent transaction advisory firm based in Paris, working globally. Sunstone Advisory advises companies, founders, family businesses and investors on M&A (buy & sell), portfolio work & exit support, and fundraising — combining investment banking and private equity experience.

Founded by Marine Charbonnier, former Senior Associate at Carlyle (European Buyout, private equity) and Associate at Deutsche Bank (investment banking). The firm's differentiator is a dual perspective: deal execution as a banker plus deal ownership as an investor, applied hands-on to every mandate with no layers or dilution.

## Services

- M&A Advisory (Buy & Sell): process preparation and management, due diligence oversight, valuation, structuring and financing, negotiation and documentation, closing.
- Portfolio Work & Exit Support: value creation execution, add-on acquisitions, investor and board interactions, financing & refinancing, equity story and business plan refinement, exit preparation.
- Fundraising Advisory: process drive and execution, equity story and materials development, Q&A preparation, investor follow-up, term sheet and documentation support.

## Why Sunstone

- Experienced partner: 20+ transactions closed across M&A advisory and private equity, from large-cap flagship investments to mid-market acquisitions, disposals, add-ons, financings and fundraisings.
- A critical sounding board: challenges analysis and pressure-tests assumptions to support well-informed decisions.
- Hands-on approach: directly involved in structuring, negotiating and driving every mandate.
- Alignment: independent, no proprietary products, no cross-selling agendas.
